base_exports.dg_means: R8 per-layer constants: per-layer norm Cn, per-layer exp and SiLU members, free per-layer shifts, one global residual scale s_x, rotation seed 1, D24 classes, D25 T4 integer head (unchanged by this spec)

what_if_flags_measured: --mult-bits q:5,k:5,v:6,o:8,g:6,u:4,d:6 --gate-pc=-5:mc8:tm4:ng4 --mods y8,fp12,a8,ah2,g4,h8 (+ SH_S/e_s +1 at 8B layer 15); ppl runs used v:7 and tm2 (see fidelity)

weights_c2.what: per-OUTPUT-channel public multiplier m_j, b bits, on every block matmul; int8 words unchanged in class
weights_c2.rule: m_j = clip(ceil(2^b * rowmax_j(W_real) / 127), 1, 2^b); W'_j = round(W_real_j * 2^b / m_j) clipped to +-127; out_j = round(m_j * acc_j / 2^(sh + b)) (same output scale)
weights_c2.condition: total shift sh + b (plus any headroom bits) must stay inside the site's counted window; v is 6 bits (not R10's 7) because the 2 attention-range bits use the top of v's two-byte window

norm_outputs.what: y (attention norm) and nm (MLP norm) int16
norm_outputs.how: tn route: tn - 8 (8B 9 -> 1, TinyLlama 10 -> 2); y = round(x g Cn / (D 2^(tn-8)))

attention_words.what: q, k, v, qr, kr, o int16 (|w| <= 32767)
attention_words.scale: 2^6 finer than today's int8 scale: 8 extra bits, 2 of them range headroom (ah2)
attention_words.q_k_shift: sh_qkv + 8 - 6 + 5 = 15 (sh_qkv = 8 in every layer of both exports)
attention_words.rope: unchanged: f_ro 7, sh_rope 7, output keeps the input scale

score.what: score word stays int8 (+-127) -> DD stays feasible
score.exp_table: unchanged per-layer member exp_generate(e_s), f_e 9, 256 rows
score.calibration_rule: the score bound must cover ALL (t, j) pairs, masked future ones too: the native relation (tlcalib.i_block) range-checks the full T x T score matrix, but the calibration statistics (raw_kv / raw_causal) are causal-only. Measured consequence: 8B layer 15 needs SH_S + 1 and e_s + 1 (masked score ~132 > 127 on LAMBADA). Alternative (native relation change, not costed): range-check only causal entries.

softmax.p_range: [0, 4096], two limbs as today (fits to F_P 15)
softmax.PV_shift: sh_o + 3 = 12; o int16 at the v scale

gate_and_silu.what: SiLU input int12 (4096-row tables) with per-channel-group tables
gate_and_silu.groups: <= 4 distinct tables per layer at T128 (<= 8 at T512: groups x 4096 <= 2^log_cols, r11 section 4); public group-id column
gate_and_silu.member_rule: channel j: e_j = finest registry e_in in [-5, -1] with 127 * 2^e_j >= min(8 x channel max, 4 x tensor max) of |gate|; then merge the finest e values into the 4th coarsest (coarser = more range); each e group takes ONE output member, the coarsest any of its channels needs (registry pairs (-5,-13) (-4,-13) (-4,-12) (-3,-12) (-3,-11) (-2,-11) (-1,-11) (-1,-10) (-1,-9))
gate_and_silu.gate_shift: sh_g + 8 - 4 + 6 = 18; the per-channel step 2^(e_j - e_in) must be folded into the gate multipliers (or words); if folded into m_j the shift may rise by up to 3 (ng4 spans <= 4 e values) and must stay <= 24 (three bytes)
gate_and_silu.output_scale: per-group output unit 2^(eo_j - e_out) folds into the down projection's public input columns (r11: no cost)
gate_and_silu.calibration_rule: use the export's FULL calibration set (incl. extra and vocabulary maxima) for the channel and tensor maxima; the measured runs used only the 30-sequence b5 statistics
gate_and_silu.one_table_option: one table per layer (no group column) cost <= 0.002 ppl at TinyLlama (LOW + score int12: 1.0025 / 1.0066 vs 1.0017 / 1.0048) and saves the +1.8 to +2.0% element-terms of the group column
